title: Wardrobe, Equipment Fit, Accessories, Props & Linked-Being Presentation Composition
objective: Implement creator-facing presentation composition for wardrobe and equipment fit, accessories, props, and linked-being presentation while preserving Inventory/Asset, equipment, relationship, mount/familiar/pet/companion, anatomy, mechanics and live-state authority.

scope.purpose: Extend the MCCS presentation stack into fit/attachment/composition of owned wardrobe, equipment, accessories, props and linked beings without becoming canonical inventory, equipment, relationship or live-state authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative humanoid and nonhumanoid presentation plans can compose owned equipment/wardrobe/props and linked-being projections deterministically with explicit fit/attachment compatibility and unresolved states, without inventory/equipment/relationship/live mutation or paid/cloud dependency.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01, MCCS-03, MCCS-05 and MCCS-06 are completed_verified foundations and are not reopened.
Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-06-triggered rotation or interstitial override; reduced MCCS strict order therefore selects MCCS-09.
Inventory/Asset and equipment owner domains retain canonical ownership, equip state, quantity, mechanics and provenance; MCCS-09 composes presentation references only.
Mount/Familiar/Pet/Companion and relationship owner domains retain canonical identity, relationship and live-state truth; linked beings are presentation composition references only.
Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form/PPIA retain canonical anatomy/topology/mechanics; CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority.
Fit, attachment, occlusion and linked-being compatibility remain explicit; unsupported or unresolved mappings may not be silently fabricated.
MCCS-09 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
ui-implementation UISR-11 and player-species MVPS-07 remain independently governed and are preserved exactly from fresh CURRENT.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue in product-development. On that command, governed-start MCCS-09 under the OPS3 FIFO publication queue; do not implement while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: MCCS-06 completed_verified; fresh DAG and reduced MCCS order select MCCS-09.
